title: Language Is Not All You Need: Aligning Perception with Language Models
layout_note: Top half: a minimal architecture read bottom-to-top - a rounded grey tray of example inputs (photos, a receipt, a waveform labelled Vision / Audition) -> a small 'Embedding' chip -> a sentence with inline green token squares -> a full-width pale-blue 'Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)' bar -> 'output'. Bottom half: three equal rounded panels of chat-style examples.
grouping: The inputs share one rounded light-grey tray, sub-labelled by modality underneath; the three example dialogues are separate rounded outlined panels of equal width side by side; the model is a single tinted bar with no internal parts.
shapes_depth: Flat, borderless pale-blue rounded bar and chip; a small robot icon at the left of the model bar; inputs as real photos and a receipt image; chat turns as speech-bubble rounded boxes, user turns pale blue and model turns pale pink; the third panel shows Raven-style puzzle glyphs.
proposed_highlight: The model name Kosmos-1 is bold at the start of the capability sentence and the MLLM is the widest, boldest element across the top; the green token squares embedded in the sentence show non-text input interleaved with words.
lesson: Show that a model reads interleaved modalities by writing a plain sentence with small coloured token squares set inline where the image would go, directly under the model bar.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2302.14045); no venue on the first page. The paper has no separate architecture diagram; this first-page teaser is its only model figure. The automatic crop included the paper title and author block; it was re-cropped by hand to the figure (page 1, y 233-652 pt).

arrangement.units: an unframed model schematic across the top half, then three rounded outlined example panels of equal width in a row
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos, a receipt image and a waveform inside one rounded grey tray, labelled Vision and Audition
arrangement.losses_at: no loss drawn; 'output' with an up-arrow at the top-right of the model bar

taxonomy.note: the figure draws the MLLM as one decoder bar over embedded multimodal input; paradigm GPT = a causal language model taking interleaved input

core.what: one full-width light-blue 'Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)' bar across the top, over a single input sentence that interleaves words with green embedding squares, standing for one model behind all modalities and tasks

relations.form: the MLLM bar spans the whole figure width above the input line and the three example panels
a grey tray of image, document and audio samples (Vision, Audition) sends one up-arrow into an 'Embedding' tag, whose green squares sit inline in the text sentence fed to the MLLM
three rounded panels at the bottom each hold a chat read top to bottom: blue prompt bubbles with images, pink answer bubbles (duck-rabbit dialogue, woodpecker question, a Raven-style puzzle)

channels.colour: light blue = both the model bar/Embedding tag and the user-side prompt bubbles (two meanings); pink = model answers; green squares = non-text embedded tokens
channels.shape: speech bubbles = dialogue turns; real photos, a receipt, a waveform and line drawings = input data
channels.line: only two up-arrows (into Embedding, out of the MLLM to 'output')
channels.frame: light-grey rounded tray = the perceivable modalities; white rounded panels = one example task each

quality.strengths: Inputs are real data (a Wall-E still, a receipt, an audio waveform) and the interleaving of modalities into a language sequence is shown concretely by green squares placed between words; the one-model-many-tasks claim is shown by a single bar over everything.
quality.weaknesses: The three example panels, which take over half the area, are not connected to the model by any line, and the model itself is an opaque bar; light blue marks both the model and the user prompts; 'Audition' is greyed out without a key saying why.

insights.structure: The top half is a three-level bottom-to-top schematic (input tray, Embedding chip, model bar) and the bottom half three equal rounded example panels, so model and capability demos are separated by whitespace.
insights.data: Inputs are real images, a receipt and a waveform in one grey tray, and the interleaved input is a sentence with three green token squares inline; demos are chat bubbles, pale blue for prompts and pale pink for model output.
insights.emphasis: The MLLM bar spans the full width in bold type with a robot icon, and 'Kosmos-1' is bold at the start of the sentence beneath it.
insights.flow: Short black up-arrows run tray -> Embedding -> sentence -> MLLM -> output; the example panels below have no arrows and are read left to right.
insights.avoid: The model is a single undifferentiated bar, so the figure says nothing about how the embedding connects to the language model; it works only as a teaser, not as an architecture reference.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
